details.label: Extended Outlook
details.text: Wednesday through Monday. Scattered thunderstorms could contain gusty wind, locally heavy rainfall, and isolated flash flooding late Wednesday afternoon and evening mainly north of Interstate 70. Locally heavy rainfall could result in isolated flash flooding again on Thursday as a cold front crosses the region.
